description: This file defines the Cron model class for the Opencart admin system, providing methods to create, delete, update, and retrieve cron job records from the database.
external_files: Opencart	ext System	ext Engine	ext Model

classes.name: Cron
classes.description: Model class for managing cron jobs in the Opencart admin system.

methods.name: addCron
methods.description: Creates a new cron record in the database with provided data.

methods.name: deleteCron
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: deleteCronByCode
methods.description: Deletes a cron record identified by its code.

methods.name: editCron
methods.description: Updates the date_modified of a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a cron record identified by cron_id.

methods.name: getCron
methods.description: Retrieves a cron record by cron_id.

methods.name: getCronByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a cron record by its code.

methods.name: getCrons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of cron records with optional filtering and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalCrons
methods.description: Returns the total count of cron records.
